# TechNest Studio

> TechNest Studio — Turning ideas into digital experiences.

TechNest Studio is an agile technology and software engineering studio based in India, providing custom web development, application engineering, operations dashboards, UI/UX design, and professional video editing for businesses worldwide.

## Website & Core

- [TechNest Studio Home](https://techneststudio.in/): Official website and portfolio of TechNest Studio.
- [About TechNest Studio](https://techneststudio.in/about): Engineering philosophy, agile core structure, and transparent pricing model.
- [Contact TechNest Studio](https://techneststudio.in/contact): Direct developer consultation, project inquiry form, and milestone estimates.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://techneststudio.in/web-development): Fast, modern, responsive business websites engineered with Next.js, React, and clean semantic code.
- [Application Development](https://techneststudio.in/app-development): User-focused Android and cross-platform mobile applications with secure cloud backend APIs.
- [Custom Software Development](https://techneststudio.in/custom-software-development): Purpose-built business software, operations dashboards, and rental booking engines.
- [UI/UX Design](https://techneststudio.in/ui-ux-design): User research, conversion-oriented UX, design systems, and Figma interactive prototypes.
- [Video Editing](https://techneststudio.in/video-editing): High-impact video editing for social media reels, YouTube, brand promos, and commercial campaigns.
- [Maintenance & Support](https://techneststudio.in/maintenance-support): Software updates, 24/7 uptime monitoring, security patching, and continuous technical support.

## Brand & Operating Model

**TechNest Studio**
**✨ Imagine • 🛠️ Build • 🚀 Transform**

- Operating Model: Agile core engineering studio with direct senior developer communication and zero agency middlemen.
- Pricing Structure: Transparent, fixed milestone-based estimates with no hidden retainers.
- Technology Stack: HTML5, Modern CSS Variables, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, Cloudflare, Vercel.
